name: push_bicycle
text: A person walks forward on the right side of a bicycle, holding the near handlebar with the left hand. The left forearm reaches across toward the bicycle without crossing the torso. Right arm swings gently. Guide the bicycle upright, feet and knees stay beside the frame and rear wheel.
